name: Toxic Stair Spikes (CR 2)
body:
Toxic Stair Spikes
CR 2

XP 600
Type mechanical; Perception DC 15; Disable Device DC 15

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset manual

Effect caltrop spikes (Atk +10 melee, 1 point of damage [as caltrops] plus poison); poison (Huge scorpion venom, DC 20 Fort; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d4 Str damage; cure 2 consecutive saves.)
